findings: Raw name/subject in email HTML — msg.name and msg.subject are interpolated into the HTML email template without HTML-escaping. Both fields come from user-submitted contact form input stored verbatim in MongoDB. A value containing '<', '>', or '"' will malform the email HTML structure. Define safeName and safeSubject with the same .replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') transform already applied to safeReply and safeMsg, then substitute them in the template.

Fail-closed auth in dev is undocumented — when CRON_SECRET is unset the route unconditionally returns 401, blocking all local test invocations. The .env.example framing implies the variable may be left blank in development, but the code treats absence as a rejection condition. Add a one-line comment in the route or a note in .env.example clarifying that CRON_SECRET must be set even locally.
